mapper.sql: select s.submission_id, s.task_id, t.title as task_title, c.course_name, s.subject_type, s.user_id, u.nick_name as student_name, p.student_no, s.group_id, g.group_name, s.content, s.remark, s.version, s.status, s.submit_time, s.draft_time, s.is_overdue, s.resubmit_deadline, s.withdraw_time, s.late_apply_status, s.late_reason, s.late_approve_by, s.late_approve_time, s.create_time, s.update_time from edu_submission s left join edu_task t on t.task_id = s.task_id left join edu_course c on c.course_id = t.course_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id left join edu_user_profile p on p.user_id = s.user_id left join edu_group g on g.group_id = s.group_id
mapper.insert: insert into edu_submission (task_id, subject_type, user_id, group_id, content, remark, version, status, submit_time, draft_time, is_overdue, resubmit_deadline, late_apply_status, late_reason, create_time) values (#{taskId}, #{subjectType}, #{userId}, #{groupId}, #{content}, #{remark}, #{version}, #{status}, #{submitTime}, #{draftTime}, #{isOverdue}, #{resubmitDeadline}, #{lateApplyStatus}, #{lateReason}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from edu_submission_file where submission_id = #{submissionId} and version = #{version}
mapper.insert:
insert into edu_submission_file (submission_id, version, file_id, file_name, file_size, file_ext, mime_type, sort_no, upload_time) values
(#{submissionId}, #{version}, #{it.fileId}, #{it.fileName}, #{it.fileSize}, #{it.fileExt}, #{it.mimeType}, #{it.sortNo}, sysdate())

insert into edu_submission_version (submission_id, version, content, file_snapshot, submit_time, operator_id) values (#{submissionId}, #{version}, #{content}, #{fileSnapshot}, sysdate(), #{operatorId})
mapper.select: select id as versionId, version, content, file_snapshot as fileSnapshot, submit_time as submitTime, operator_id as operatorId from edu_submission_version where submission_id = #{submissionId} order by version desc
select return_reason from edu_review where submission_id = #{submissionId} and is_return = '1' order by review_id desc limit 1
select count(1) from edu_submission where task_id = #{taskId} and status = #{status}
